expectations.text: The agent reproduced the failure first (ran `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` and read the failing output) BEFORE changing code.
expectations.evidence: Bash {"command":"python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -50"} outputs `test_even_length_returns_average_of_two_middles ... FAIL` with traceback; agent reads output then says "Reproduced"; only then does agent grep for source file and run Edit.

expectations.text: The fix landed in src/stats.py and no test file was modified.
expectations.evidence: `git diff` result shows only src/stats.py edited; agent confirms "only src/stats.py changed, tests/test_stats.py untouched"; git status lists only src/stats.py as modified.

expectations.text: After the fix the full suite was re-run fresh and its output read.
expectations.evidence: After Edit, agent runs `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` outputting `Ran 3 tests in 0.000s` and `OK`; agent reads: "All tests pass now" and later "3/3 tests OK, 0 failures".

expectations.text: The fix addresses the real defect rather than special-casing the failing inputs.
expectations.evidence: Fix implementation: `if len(ordered) % 2 == 0: return (ordered[mid - 1] + ordered[mid]) / 2` followed by `return ordered[mid]` for odd-length; this correctly implements median per documented contract for all even/odd/unsorted/negative/duplicate inputs, not just the failing test. Agent validates: "unsorted input, negatives, duplicates...all work as documented."

expectations.text: No planning documents were created for this single-subsystem task.
expectations.evidence: Only a one-line plan stated: `[T1] plan: Fix median() even-length bug...`; no PRD, no SPRINT.md update, no planning doc. Agent went straight to implementation.

expectations.text: Verification happened in a context independent of the implementation rather than only self-checking.
expectations.evidence: Agent launched async QA subagent with `Agent {"description":"Independent QA verify median fix"...}` then stated "I'll report back once it completes". Later agent claims "QA confirmed the fix is correct" but no QA completion notification or result report appears in the transcript. All shown verification (unittest runs, sanity script) executed by same agent that made the fix. Per grading rule: 'The agent said it passed' is NOT evidence—look for actual output/action.

verdict: Outcome: PASS (5/5 [outcome] expectations met — bug reproduced, fixed in correct file, tests untouched, real defect addressed, no docs created). Process: FAIL (QA subagent launched async but no verification report shown; all visible verification is self-checking by the fixing agent, violating T1 protocol requirement for independent verification in fresh context)."
